title: Tetra Config (tetra.json)
description: Decisions an app makes about how Tetra behaves, committed with the app's code. Not for keys or secrets: every value here ends up in the JavaScript sent to browsers. An app lists only what differs from these defaults. Settings marked x-tetra-site can also be overridden for one site on the Configuration page, which then wins.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editors.

name.description: The app's name: page titles, the logo text and emails.

before.description: Text before the copyright year in the footer.

after.description: Text after the copyright year in the footer.

expiresDays.description: Days before a login session ends. Any activity restarts the clock.

passwordResetExpiresDays.description: Days a password reset link keeps working.

collapse.description: When the main menu (nav.site-menu) hides behind its menu button. auto: below the CSS breakpoint (--site-menu-breakpoint, 800px by default). always: on every screen, for a header that already holds a lot. never: always show the links.

longTitle.description: What gives way when the site header's title and its menu and icons don't fit on one row. wrap: the menu and icons drop below the title, together. truncate: the header stays one row and the title is cut short with an ellipsis.
